fusions.name: Spore Burst
fusions.desc: Spores burst from you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it. You heal 10 health.

fusions.name: Spawn Pellet
fusions.desc: Spits a pellet of spores that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 25%. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mat
fusions.desc: Raises a mat of mycelium where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Feeding Spores
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
